section.title: Writing a dynamic profile
section.para: It is not unusual that you need to write a profile that adapts dynamically to the underlying system. For instance, you might want Agama to take some decisions depending on the hardware of the system you are installing.

Fortunately, Jsonnet can work as a templating language and it offers many structures that allow generating data. For that reason, Agama injects the hardware information that you can process using the powerful Jsonnet standard library.
You can access to the hardware information by importing the hw.libsonnet library, as you can see in the example below.
Agama ships a few helpers to make it easier to search for the information you need from the hardware tree. See agama.libsonnet for further details.
You can inspect the available data by installing the lshw package and running the following command: lshw -json.
